sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) AS buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) AS refund_buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id ELSE NULL END) AS selling_store_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_items
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 在青禾当前客户数据范围内，统计窗口为2026年8月（2026-08-01至2026-09-01），按CRM会员账户口径：购买会员数为16,504个账户；退款会员数为4,173个账户；成交门店数为24家；有效订单商品件数为120,210件。购买会员数指窗口内有有效订单的不同会员账户数；退款会员数指窗口内发生退款的已支付订单所关联的不同会员账户数。有效订单商品件数是有效订单中的原始购买件数合计，不是净商品销量；退款金额不能用于推算退货件数。
question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的购买会员数、退款会员数、成交门店数和有效订单商品件数分别是多少？
